assessmentMethod: Internal fit score only; it is not a market-quality or market-size rank.

selectedDomains.selectionReason: The product's central job is discovering, comparing, and monitoring deal prices through filters and 30-day price history.
User posts, votes, comments, reporting, and sold-out reports make community validation a core supporting loop.
The product helps users spend less, but verified current scope is deal discovery rather than a checkout coupon engine.

comparators.name: HotUKDeals
comparators.observed: Free community deal platform; member voting creates a temperature signal and comments validate deals.
comparators.selectionReason: Strong direct analogue for community-ranked deal discovery.

comparators.name: Dealabs
comparators.observed: Keyword/merchant/category alerts with optional price filters and web/mobile notification settings.
comparators.selectionReason: Direct evidence for an alert-management pattern across web and mobile.

comparators.name: Slickdeals
comparators.observed: Official help documents deal alerts, search, voting, commenting, expired-deal reporting, reputation, and a personalized front page.
comparators.selectionReason: Direct deal-community comparator with verified moderation and discovery surfaces.

comparators.name: PayPal Honey
comparators.observed: Droplist tracks selected items across supported stores and notifies members when prices fall below a chosen amount.
comparators.selectionReason: Leading reference for clear price-watch lifecycle and notification expectations.

comparators.name: Ppomppu
comparators.observed: Project origin names it as a clone, but this analysis did not use an official feature source sufficient for comparable scoring.
comparators.selectionReason: Keep as a local research lead only; do not use it in calculated benchmark.

benchmarkEligibility.caveat: Comparator scores are transparent analyst normalizations of publicly verified capabilities, not market measurements, ratings, prices, or usage data.
